$comment: A DELIBERATELY WRONG manifest. It exists so that 'the journey can fail' is a command
a later session can run, rather than a claim in a review nobody can re-check.
Expected: NON-ZERO, with three findings -- one per wrong thing below. If this ever
exits 0 the journey has stopped checking and every green run it has ever reported is
worth nothing. A journey that cannot fail is a screenshot.
It is NOT read by tests/e2e/test_pc01_journey_conformance.py: that guard reads
manifest.json only, so the three wrongs here never redden the gate.

routes.name: wrong-call
routes.$wrong: the projects screen calls listProjects, not listRuns. Expect: 'declares GET /bff/v1/runs but the browser did not make it'.

routes.name: route-that-does-not-exist
routes.$wrong: no such screen. Expect: 'the document answered 404'.
routes.$measured: This was first written as /projects/there-is-no-such-screen and it answered 200, not 404: /projects/[project_uid] matches any segment, so an unrouted PROJECT path renders the project screen in an error state. Only an unrouted TOP-LEVEL path 404s. Confirmed by curl at 2026-09-19: /projects/there-is-no-such-screen -> 200, /projects/prj_01M2T7DTGFN0G83S7PVC2EDM99 -> 200, /there-is-no-such-top-level-route -> 404.

routes.name: link-that-is-never-rendered
routes.$wrong: the projects screen renders no link of this shape, so the walk cannot continue. Expect: 'rendered no link matching ...' and a stop, with the routes after it reported as NOT checked.

routes.name: never-reached
routes.$wrong: the route after the broken follow. The journey must report it as NOT checked rather than as passing.
